title: Concept: POST form without a CSRF token
description: A form that posts and carries no anti-CSRF field in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: Without a token the endpoint accepts a request the browser sends on behalf of a logged-in user from another site, so an attacker can submit the action with the victim's session.
applicability: Transfers, profile changes, card controls and any form that changes state.
risk: A forged request executes with the victim's session and moves money or changes credentials.
